lines.zh: 长发垂到腰，走路带着风。
lines.en: My long hair falls to my waist and pulls wind behind me.

lines.zh: 我一步落下，地面塌了一小块。
lines.en: I take a step and a patch of ground gives way.
My brow is bare. No eyebrows left.

lines.zh: 这形态太沉，我不敢快走。
lines.en: This form is too heavy; I don't dare walk fast.

lines.zh: 头发在身后拖着，像披风。
lines.en: My hair drags behind me like a cloak.

lines.zh: 每走一步，气就漏出一丝。
lines.en: With every step a thread of ki leaks out.

lines.zh: 空气被我挤得往两边跑。
lines.en: The air is squeezed aside around me.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，地上的石头先碎。
lines.en: I lift my foot and the stones crack first.
This form doesn't last long.

lines.zh: 我走得稳，是因为不能失手。
lines.en: I walk steadily because I can't afford to slip.

lines.zh: 电已经不太明显了，只剩压。
lines.en: The lightning is subtle now; only the pressure remains.
The wind splits in two in front of me.
I stand with my long hair reaching the ground.
Between my breaths the dirt is blown aside.

lines.zh: 这个形态，连安静都压人。
lines.en: Even standing still, this form presses down.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看天，云走得很快。
lines.en: I look up; the clouds are moving fast.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸眉骨，什么都没了。
lines.en: I touch my brow. Nothing there.
I'm counting how much time is left.

lines.zh: 气在体内转，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: My ki turns inside me, round after round.

lines.zh: 脚下的土，一直在往下沉。
lines.en: The ground under me keeps sinking.
I don't move, and no bird dares land.

lines.zh: 长发被气托着，浮在半空。
lines.en: My long hair floats, held up by ki.

lines.zh: 这一层，比上一层更孤独。
lines.en: This level is lonelier than the last.
I shut my eyes and listen to the distance.
Ki at my fingertips pushes the dust away.
Right. That's about enough.
Get a good look? This is the third level.

lines.zh: 我的长发挡住了半张脸。
lines.en: My long hair hides half my face.

lines.zh: 没有眉毛，看着更凶，是吧。
lines.en: No eyebrows makes me look fiercer, doesn't it.
You're still panting. I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 这个形态，我不想用在你身上。
lines.en: I didn't want to use this form on you.

lines.zh: 你站着没退，倒有些骨气
lines.en: You did not step back; there is some spine in you.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，头发先垂下来。
lines.en: As I look down, my hair comes first.
Your ki looks thin to me.
Don't come closer. Truly.

lines.zh: 这一层，压得人抬不起头。
lines.en: This level forces heads down.
One glance from me and you understand.

lines.zh: 你手在抖，我看见发梢在动。
lines.en: Your hands shake; I see my hair tips tremble.

lines.zh: 我还没出手，地已经在响。
lines.en: I haven't struck and the ground already groans.
If you want to yield, do it now.

lines.zh: 这个形态，我撑不了太久。
lines.en: I can't hold this form long.
I'm not showing off.
You're still standing. That's something.
Back up ten paces and I'll talk.
The shockwave throws my long hair back.
Blood glues my long hair to my face.
It hurts, but this form can take it.
My hair grew long, and my ki is leaking.
I wipe my face; the blood still runs.
Good. You really do have skill.
I grit my teeth and pull my ki back up.
This form won't last much longer.
I drop to one knee, then rise.

lines.zh: 再打下去，我就退回去了。
lines.en: One more hit and I'll drop back down.
Let me sit and bank my ki first.
Eating in this form breaks the bowl.

lines.zh: 我小心地夹，还是捏扁了。
lines.en: I pick it up carefully and still crush it.
The smell gets in and my stomach gets louder.
This meal will have to be enormous.

lines.zh: 我低头吃，长发垂进碗里。
lines.en: I eat, and my long hair falls into the bowl.
I'll power down after eating. Don't worry.
I'll remember your cooking.
Another bowl. I can hold on.
I set the bowl down; my hair still floats.
You hit me and go back three paces.
I put a hand out so you don't get hurt.

lines.zh: 这一身气压得你弯了腰。
lines.en: The pressure of this form bends you over.
I step back and the ground caves in.
My long hair brushes your face.
Don't press in. I can't control it.

lines.zh: 我们撞出的响声，传得很远。
lines.en: The noise we make carries a long way.
You didn't fall. I'm almost impressed.
Stand firm. I'm coming through.
No one blames anyone for that one.

lines.zh: 我得先退回去，才能说话。
lines.en: I have to power down before I can speak.

lines.zh: 这个形态，连碰都不能碰。
lines.en: In this form I can't even touch anyone.
Only when my hair falls do I smile.
Some things can't be bought with power.

lines.zh: 我把气收了，肩才松下来。
lines.en: I bank my ki and my shoulders finally loosen.

lines.zh: 这形态不该出现在家里。
lines.en: This form doesn't belong at home.
I reach out. This time it won't hurt.
She scolds me and I laugh.
I promised I'd come back safe.

lines.zh: 这一层，我一个人担着就好。
lines.en: This level I'll carry alone.
I pick it up between two fingers.
My hair gets in the way; I tuck it back.
The bowl feels like paper in my hand.
I eat slowly. I don't dare bite down hard.

lines.zh: 这点东西，不够这一层烧。
lines.en: That's not enough fuel for this form.

lines.zh: 我把它放进怀里，压平了。
lines.en: I tuck it in my shirt and flatten it.

lines.zh: 我低头咬住，头发又垂了。
lines.en: I bend to bite it and my hair falls again.
Finished. My ki has steadied a little.
I brush the crumbs off my hands.
Was that enough? I want more.
That ki of his is pinned under mine.
I raise my eyes and he steps back.

lines.zh: 这个形态，锁定就是压住。
lines.en: In this form locking on means pinning down.
He's already inside my reach.
I lift a foot and the dirt flies up first.
Running faster won't help him.
I take the shortest line.
My hair streams back. I'm about to move.
His ki is shrinking. He's afraid.
In this form I must pull my blows.
I watch his waist.
From here, a step and a half.
When I move, the air can't keep up.

lines.zh: 他不该站在这片空地上。
lines.en: He shouldn't have stood in this open ground.
I raise my right hand.
Last warning.
He moves, and I'm already there.

lines.zh: 残影还没散，我已经回来了。
lines.en: The afterimage hasn't faded and I'm back.

lines.zh: 他连我的方向都摸不准。
lines.en: He can't even tell which way I went.
I stop at his flank without a sound.
My long hair floats up and gives me away.
He swings and hits nothing three times.
I shift only half a step at a time.
His breathing is ragged now.
I'll let him wear himself out.
He backs to the cliff edge and stops.
I raise a hand and ki gathers at his feet.
He's decided to go all out.
I'm in no hurry. Time is mine.
In this form, standing here is enough.

lines.zh: 他抬头看我，眼里没火了。
lines.en: He looks up at me, the fire gone from his eyes.
I take one more step.
All right. That's the end of it.
I raise both palms.
The Dragon Fist bursts out of my hand.
Meteor combination, blow after blow.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下，地面开了口。
lines.en: I bring a fist down and the ground opens.

lines.zh: 长发跟着我的动作甩起来。
lines.en: My long hair whips with the motion.
He blocks and his arm cracks.
My kick snaps a row of trees.
I didn't dare use full strength on that.
He backs off coughing blood.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的手腕，又松开。
lines.en: I catch his wrist, then let go.
The wind of my palm throws him ten paces.
I land and my feet sink half a foot.
In this form, holding back is harder than striking.
He's still getting up.
Fine. Then this is where it ends.
I stop and my long hair settles.
The ki is receding.
My long hair falls out of the light first.
I land and the ground collapses in a ring.

lines.zh: 眉骨光着，眼睛变了颜色。
lines.en: Bare brow, and my eyes have changed color.
I can't hold this level long.
The air shivers around me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，云被推开一道口。
lines.en: I look up and the clouds part in a seam.

lines.zh: 脚下的碎石浮起来又落下。
lines.en: Gravel lifts and falls back at my feet.
Someone in the distance has dropped to their knees.

lines.zh: 我把气收了一成，怕伤到地。
lines.en: I pull my ki in a tenth so I don't hurt the land.
My hair reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 这个形态，是最后的手段。
lines.en: This form is a last resort.
Thunder is still rolling far away.
I clench my fist and light leaks between the fingers.
The wind stops when it reaches me.
I glance at my own hand.
Who's worth going this far for?
The soil turns to ash under my feet.

lines.zh: 我把长发甩到身后，站定。
lines.en: I throw my long hair back and plant my feet.

lines.zh: 火烧到长发，我一把掐灭。
lines.en: Fire catches my long hair and I crush it out.

lines.zh: 我从天上掉下来，砸穿了石层。
lines.en: I fall out of the sky and punch through stone.

lines.zh: 水里我屏着气，长发缠住我。
lines.en: Underwater my long hair tangles around me.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起土浪，我站住了。
lines.en: The blast lifts a wave of earth and I hold my ground.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩头，电把它烧焦
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shoulder; my lightning burns it black.
Foul magic locks my limbs.

lines.zh: 空着肚子，这一层撑不住。
lines.en: On an empty stomach this form fails.

lines.zh: 雷打在长发上，我笑了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my long hair and I smile.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，长发往上飘。
lines.en: No ground below, and my long hair floats upward.
